title: sentilab-open-check/1
description: GET /api/open/v1/check-status?h=<request_sha256> (DESIGN rev 3 sections 6.2 and 10): the routed wire W(c) in mm, the router status, and nominal q_r = W(c) - (1 + r) W_R for r = 0, the policy tolerance and every tradeoff budget, under the fixed labels "routed wire only, no thermal solve, nominal, not a score". It carries no geometry. W_c_mm is a number only for a proven optimum; otherwise it and every q_r read UNKNOWN. codes is empty for a routed result and holds the rejection or check_unfinished codes otherwise (rev 3 shows only the routed shape).

router_status.description: optimal: proven by HiGHS with mip_rel_gap 0 within the solver limit (section 4.5). time_limit: the solver limit ended it. not_routed: rejected before routing, or the wall or CPU reserve ended it.
